query: SELECT id, packageCode, trackingNumber, customerId FROM packages WHERE trackingNumber IN (SELECT trackingNumber FROM packages WHERE trackingNumber IS NOT NULL AND trackingNumber != '' GROUP BY trackingNumber HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY trackingNumber, id;
